Error Codes.errorMeaning: Circulation water temperature overheat protection
Error Codes.possibleSolution: Flow rate may be reduced. Check for water leakage, strainer blockage and water circulation pump function. The code may display during filling of the primary circuit; complete filling and reset the error code.

Error Codes.errorMeaning: DHW tank water temperature overheat protection
Error Codes.possibleSolution: Check the immersion heater and its contactor.

Error Codes.errorMeaning: Indoor unit temperature thermistor (THW1, THW2, THW5, THW6, THW7, THW8, THW9) failure
Error Codes.possibleSolution: Check resistance across the thermistor.

Error Codes.errorMeaning: Circulation water freeze protection
Error Codes.possibleSolution: Flow rate may be reduced. Check for water leakage, strainer blockage and water circulation pump function. The code may display during filling of the primary circuit; complete filling and reset the error code.

Error Codes.errorMeaning: Heating operation error
Error Codes.possibleSolution: Re-attach any thermistors that have become dislodged.

Error Codes.errorMeaning: Low primary circuit flow rate detected by flow switch (flow switches 1, 2, 3)
Error Codes.possibleSolution: Flow rate may be reduced. Check for water leakage, strainer blockage and water circulation pump function. The code may display during filling of the primary circuit; complete filling and reset the error code. If the flow switch itself does not work, replace it. Caution: the pump valves may be hot.

Error Codes.errorMeaning: Boiler circulation water temperature overheat protection
Error Codes.possibleSolution: Check whether the boiler heating temperature setting exceeds the restriction; see the PAC-TH011HT-E thermistor manual. Flow rate of the heating circuit from the boiler may be reduced. Check for water leakage, strainer blockage and water circulation pump function.

Error Codes.errorMeaning: Boiler temperature thermistor (THWB1, THWB2) failure
Error Codes.possibleSolution: Check resistance across the thermistor.

Error Codes.errorMeaning: Boiler operation error
Error Codes.possibleSolution: Re-attach any thermistors that have become dislodged. Check the status of the boiler.

Error Codes.errorMeaning: Boiler circulation water freeze protection
Error Codes.possibleSolution: Flow rate of the heating circuit from the boiler may be reduced. Check for water leakage, strainer blockage and water circulation pump function.

Error Codes.errorMeaning: Setting errors of DIP switches on FTC4 control board
Error Codes.possibleSolution: For boiler operation, check DIP SW1-1 is ON (With Boiler) and DIP SW2-6 is ON (With Mixing Tank). For 2-zone temperature control, check DIP SW2-7 is ON (2-zone) and DIP SW2-6 is ON (With Mixing Tank).

Error Codes.errorMeaning: Communication failure between FTC4 and wireless receiver
Error Codes.possibleSolution: Check connection cable for damage or loose connections.

Error Codes.errorMeaning: Thermistor (room temperature) (TH1) failure
Error Codes.possibleSolution: Check resistance across the thermistor.

Error Codes.errorMeaning: Thermistor (refrigerant liquid temperature) (TH2) failure
Error Codes.possibleSolution: Check resistance across the thermistor.

Error Codes.errorMeaning: Anti-freeze protection of plate heat exchanger
Error Codes.possibleSolution: Flow rate may be reduced. Check for water leakage, strainer blockage and water circulation pump function. The code may display during filling of the primary circuit; complete filling and reset the error code. Check for correct amount of refrigerant.

Error Codes.errorMeaning: Communication failure between wireless receiver and wireless remote controller
Error Codes.possibleSolution: Check the wireless remote controller battery is not flat. Check pairing between the wireless receiver and wireless remote controller. Test wireless communication; see the wireless system manual.

Error Codes.errorMeaning: Communication failure between main controller and FTC4
Error Codes.possibleSolution: Check connection cable for damage or loose connections.

Error Codes.errorMeaning: Communication failure between FTC4 and outdoor unit
Error Codes.possibleSolution: Check that the outdoor unit has not been turned off. Check connection cable for damage or loose connections. Refer to the outdoor unit service manual.

Error Codes.errorMeaning: Outdoor unit receives no signal from indoor unit
Error Codes.possibleSolution: Check both units are switched on. Check connection cable for damage or loose connections. Refer to the outdoor unit service manual.

Error Codes.errorMeaning: Outdoor unit failure
Error Codes.possibleSolution: Refer to the outdoor unit service manual.
